sents.zh: 很久以前，人们不在纸上写字，因为那时候还没有纸。
sents.en: Long ago people did not write on paper, because there was none.

sents.zh: 他们把字写在竹子上面。
sents.en: They wrote on strips of bamboo.

sents.zh: 一本书要用很多很多竹子。
sents.en: One book took a great deal of bamboo.

sents.zh: 所以书又重又大，一个人拿不动。
sents.en: So a book was heavy and bulky, and one person could not carry it.

sents.zh: 如果要送一本书给朋友，那是很难的事。
sents.en: If you wanted to send a friend a book, it was a hard thing to do.

sents.zh: 后来，有一个人想到了一个办法。
sents.en: Later a man thought of a way.

sents.zh: 他用树皮和旧布，先放到水里。
sents.en: He took tree bark and old cloth and put them in water.

sents.zh: 然后他把它们做得又白又轻。
sents.en: Then he worked them until they were white and light.
Paper is light, and not expensive.

sents.zh: 有了纸，学生可以带书上学。
sents.en: With paper, students could carry books to school.

sents.zh: 老师也可以把课文写下来给大家看。
sents.en: Teachers could write out lessons for everyone to read.

sents.zh: 因为纸很好用，所以它慢慢到了别的国家。
sents.en: Because paper was so useful, it slowly reached other countries.

sents.zh: 今天，世界上的人都在用纸，这是从中国开始的。
sents.en: Today people all over the world use paper, and it began in China.
